provenance.calculation: The pinned upstream OpenCode source's own dependency recipe (nix/node_modules.nix), evaluated with this repository's locked nixpkgs as the OpenCode input follows it, which supplies the Bun 1.4.4 the derivation actually builds with; frozen lock and both upstream normalization scripts. ARM targets use --cpu=arm64 --os=linux/darwin with --ignore-scripts.

verification.x86_64-linux: Native upstream node_modules_updater build on the followed nixpkgs; the replay reproduced the previous pin before the source bump. CLI and Desktop not built locally.
verification.aarch64-linux: --cpu=arm64 --os=linux replayed through the same derivation on x86_64-linux: fixed-output hash recorded; no native build.
verification.aarch64-darwin: --cpu=arm64 --os=darwin replayed through the same derivation on x86_64-linux: fixed-output hash recorded; no native build.
